certificate_badge_states_suspension_chec.name: certificate_badge_states_suspension_check
certificate_badge_states_suspension_chec.value: ("certificate_badge_states"."suspendedAt" IS NULL AND "certificate_badge_states"."suspensionReason" IS NULL) OR ("certificate_badge_states"."suspendedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "certificate_badge_states"."suspensionReason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("certificate_badge_states"."suspensionReason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)

customer_content_approval_check.name: customer_content_approval_check
customer_content_approval_check.value: ("customer_content_versions"."approved_at" IS NULL AND "customer_content_versions"."approved_by_staff_id" IS NULL AND "customer_content_versions"."status" <> 'APPROVED') OR ("customer_content_versions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_content_versions"."approved_by_staff_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_content_versions"."approved_by_staff_id" <> "customer_content_versions"."owner_staff_id" AND "customer_content_versions"."status" <> 'DRAFT')

customer_content_withdrawal_check.name: customer_content_withdrawal_check
customer_content_withdrawal_check.value: ("customer_content_versions"."status" = 'WITHDRAWN' AND "customer_content_versions"."withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_content_versions"."withdrawn_by_staff_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_content_versions"."withdrawal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("customer_content_versions"."withdrawal_reason")) > 0) OR ("customer_content_versions"."status" <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND "customer_content_versions"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL AND "customer_content_versions"."withdrawn_by_staff_id" IS NULL AND "customer_content_versions"."withdrawal_reason" IS NULL)

customers_anonymised_check.name: customers_anonymised_check
customers_anonymised_check.value: "customers"."anonymisedAt" IS NULL OR "customers"."deletedAt" IS NOT NULL

documents_pending_deletion_idx.name: documents_pending_deletion_idx
documents_pending_deletion_idx.where: "documents"."deletionStartedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "documents"."deletedAt" IS NULL

inspections_policy_root_key.name: inspections_policy_root_key
inspections_policy_root_key.where: "inspections"."policyNumber" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."claimNumber" IS NULL AND "inspections"."predecessorId" IS NULL

inspections_later_successor_key.name: inspections_later_successor_key
inspections_later_successor_key.where: "inspections"."policyNumber" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."predecessorId" IS NOT NULL

inspections_underwriting_check.name: inspections_underwriting_check
inspections_underwriting_check.value: "inspections"."purpose" <> 'UNDERWRITING' OR ("inspections"."quoteRequestId" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."method" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."stage" IS NOT NULL)

inspections_later_links_check.name: inspections_later_links_check
inspections_later_links_check.value:
("inspections"."purpose"::text IN ('GENERAL', 'UNDERWRITING') AND "inspections"."policyNumber" IS NULL AND "inspections"."claimNumber" IS NULL)
      OR ("inspections"."purpose"::text = 'AFTER_PAYMENT' AND "inspections"."policyNumber" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."insurerId" IS NOT NULL
        AND "inspections"."method" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."stage" = 'AFTER_PAYMENT' AND "inspections"."stage" IS NOT NULL
        AND "inspections"."claimNumber" IS NULL AND "inspections"."quoteRequestId" IS NULL)
      OR ("inspections"."purpose"::text = 'CLAIM_ASSESSMENT' AND "inspections"."policyNumber" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."insurerId" IS NOT NULL
        AND "inspections"."method" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."claimNumber" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."stage" IS NULL AND "inspections"."quoteRequestId" IS NULL)

insurer_product_versions_inspection_rule.name: insurer_product_versions_inspection_rule_check
insurer_product_versions_inspection_rule.value:
("insurer_product_versions"."inspectionRule" = 'NOT_REQUIRED' AND "insurer_product_versions"."inspectionTiming" IS NULL AND "insurer_product_versions"."inspectionMethod" IS NULL)
        OR ("insurer_product_versions"."inspectionRule" <> 'NOT_REQUIRED' AND "insurer_product_versions"."inspectionTiming" IS NOT NULL AND "insurer_product_versions"."inspectionMethod" IS NOT NULL)

insurer_profile_revisions_content_check.name: insurer_profile_revisions_content_check
insurer_profile_revisions_content_check.value: length(trim("insurer_profile_revisions"."brandName")) BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND length(trim("insurer_profile_revisions"."description")) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND length(trim("insurer_profile_revisions"."serviceInformation")) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000

quote_information_requests_answer_check.name: quote_information_requests_answer_check
quote_information_requests_answer_check.value:
("quote_information_requests"."answeredAt" IS NULL) = ("quote_information_requests"."answerText" IS NULL)
        AND ("quote_information_requests"."answeredAt" IS NULL OR "quote_information_requests"."closedAt" IS NOT NULL)

quote_request_product_versions_inspectio.name: quote_request_product_versions_inspection_rule_check
quote_request_product_versions_inspectio.value:
("quote_request_product_versions"."inspectionRule" = 'NOT_REQUIRED' AND "quote_request_product_versions"."inspectionTiming" IS NULL AND "quote_request_product_versions"."inspectionMethod" IS NULL)
        OR ("quote_request_product_versions"."inspectionRule" <> 'NOT_REQUIRED' AND "quote_request_product_versions"."inspectionTiming" IS NOT NULL AND "quote_request_product_versions"."inspectionMethod" IS NOT NULL)

quote_request_product_versions_decline_c.name: quote_request_product_versions_decline_check
quote_request_product_versions_decline_c.value:
("quote_request_product_versions"."status" = 'DECLINED') = ("quote_request_product_versions"."declineReasonCode" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("quote_request_product_versions"."declineCustomerNote" IS NULL OR "quote_request_product_versions"."declineReasonCode" IS NOT NULL)

reconciliation_items_resolution_check.name: reconciliation_items_resolution_check
reconciliation_items_resolution_check.value: ("reconciliation_items"."status" = 'RESOLVED') = ("reconciliation_items"."resolvedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "reconciliation_items"."outcome" IS NOT NULL)

review_appeals_outcome_check.name: review_appeals_outcome_check
review_appeals_outcome_check.value:
("review_appeals"."outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "review_appeals"."outcome" IN ('UPHELD','OVERTURNED') AND "review_appeals"."decidedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "review_appeals"."decidedBy" IS NOT NULL AND "review_appeals"."outcomeReason" IS NOT NULL)
         OR ("review_appeals"."outcome" IS NULL AND "review_appeals"."decidedAt" IS NULL AND "review_appeals"."decidedBy" IS NULL AND "review_appeals"."outcomeReason" IS NULL)

review_revisions_kind_rating_check.name: review_revisions_kind_rating_check
review_revisions_kind_rating_check.value:
("review_revisions"."kind" = 'REVIEW' AND "review_revisions"."purgedAt" IS NULL AND "review_revisions"."rating" IS NOT NULL AND "review_revisions"."rating" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
        OR ("review_revisions"."kind" = 'REVIEW' AND "review_revisions"."purgedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "review_revisions"."rating" IS NULL)
        OR ("review_revisions"."kind" = 'RESPONSE' AND "review_revisions"."rating" IS NULL)

review_revisions_purged_check.name: review_revisions_purged_check
review_revisions_purged_check.value:
"review_revisions"."purgedAt" IS NULL OR
        ("review_revisions"."retiredAt" IS NOT NULL AND "review_revisions"."text" IS NULL AND "review_revisions"."status" IN ('REJECTED','REMOVED','SUPERSEDED'))

review_revisions_published_check.name: review_revisions_published_check
review_revisions_published_check.value: "review_revisions"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' OR ("review_revisions"."publishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "review_revisions"."purgedAt" IS NULL)

risk_review_evidence_check.name: risk_review_evidence_check
risk_review_evidence_check.value: "risk_review_flags"."evidenceReference" = CASE WHEN "risk_review_flags"."quoteId" IS NOT NULL THEN 'quote:' || "risk_review_flags"."quoteId"::text ELSE 'reconciliation:' || "risk_review_flags"."reconciliationItemId"::text END

risk_review_values_check.name: risk_review_values_check
risk_review_values_check.value: "risk_review_flags"."severity" IN ('LOW','MEDIUM','HIGH') AND "risk_review_flags"."status" IN ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','RESOLVED') AND "risk_review_flags"."workflowEffect" = 'METADATA_ONLY' AND "risk_review_flags"."version" > 0 AND length(btrim("risk_review_flags"."reason")) BETWEEN 10 AND 1000 AND length(btrim("risk_review_flags"."nextAction")) BETWEEN 3 AND 500

risk_review_resolution_check.name: risk_review_resolution_check
risk_review_resolution_check.value: ("risk_review_flags"."status" = 'RESOLVED' AND "risk_review_flags"."outcome" IN ('NO_ACTION','REFERRED') AND "risk_review_flags"."outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "risk_review_flags"."resolutionReason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("risk_review_flags"."resolutionReason")) BETWEEN 10 AND 1000 AND "risk_review_flags"."resolvedByStaffId" IS NOT NULL AND "risk_review_flags"."resolvedAt" IS NOT NULL) OR ("risk_review_flags"."status" <> 'RESOLVED' AND "risk_review_flags"."outcome" IS NULL AND "risk_review_flags"."resolutionReason" IS NULL AND "risk_review_flags"."resolvedByStaffId" IS NULL AND "risk_review_flags"."resolvedAt" IS NULL)

risk_review_owner_check.name: risk_review_owner_check
risk_review_owner_check.value: "risk_review_flags"."status" = 'RESOLVED' OR ("risk_review_flags"."status" = 'OPEN' AND "risk_review_flags"."ownerStaffId" IS NULL) OR ("risk_review_flags"."status" = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND "risk_review_flags"."ownerStaffId" IS NOT NULL)

service_requests_decided_check.name: service_requests_decided_check
service_requests_decided_check.value: ("service_requests"."decision" IS NULL) = ("service_requests"."decidedAt" IS NULL) AND ("service_requests"."decision" IS NULL) = ("service_requests"."decidedByStaffId" IS NULL)

service_requests_status_decision_check.name: service_requests_status_decision_check
service_requests_status_decision_check.value: ("service_requests"."status" NOT IN ('APPROVED', 'COMPLETED') OR "service_requests"."decision" = 'APPROVED') AND ("service_requests"."decision" IS DISTINCT FROM 'APPROVED' OR "service_requests"."status" IN ('APPROVED', 'COMPLETED', 'WITHDRAWN')) AND ("service_requests"."status" = 'DECLINED') = ("service_requests"."decision" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'DECLINED')

service_requests_cancellation_check.name: service_requests_cancellation_check
service_requests_cancellation_check.value:
("service_requests"."type" = 'CANCELLATION') = ("service_requests"."requestedEffectiveDate" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("service_requests"."type" = 'CANCELLATION' OR ("service_requests"."refundAmountMinor" IS NULL AND "service_requests"."effectiveDate" IS NULL))
        AND ("service_requests"."type" <> 'CANCELLATION' OR "service_requests"."decision" IS DISTINCT FROM 'APPROVED' OR ("service_requests"."refundAmountMinor" IS NOT NULL AND "service_requests"."effectiveDate" IS NOT NULL))
